lastCompletedStory.title: Fix cam-plan.md selection description to champion-vs-champion

nextStoryContext: US-003 rewrote the no-argument selection bullet (line 11) in both .claude/commands/cam-plan.md and templates/commands/cam-plan.md: replaced the stale 'sorted by rank asc then numeric id asc' claim with an accurate description of selectPlannableIssue's champion-vs-champion logic (src/issues/select.ts:66-86) - best ranked candidate by min rank vs best unranked candidate by max WSJF via computeWsjf, unranked wins only on strictly-higher WSJF, ties go to ranked. Kept the surrounding main-ref/fallback-only text on the same line intact. Ran bun run embed-vendor to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts; embed-vendor:check clean. Did not touch scripts/cam/patterns.md: the champion-vs-champion behavior and three-copy cam-plan sync requirement are already documented there (bullets referencing CAM-203/US-001/US-002, CAM-222) - this story was purely a docs-drift fix on cam-plan.md matching that already-documented behavior, no new reusable insight. If a future story finds prd.json exhausted of non-operator passes:false stories, check whether the patterns.md bullet at the CAM-106 entry (line ~171, 'sort order is rank ascending... then id ascending') is now misleading relative to the later champion-vs-champion entries - it predates CAM-203 and describes an earlier version of select.ts; out of scope for US-003 but worth a follow-up issue if noticed again.
